fields.status: Android is an official supported build distributed as an APK; the current guide specifies Android 7.0 (API 24)+. Setup is manual, phone UI and controls are not optimized, and first launch may take several attempts. The phone must also have assets copied from an original Windows RCT2 or RCT Classic desktop installation. The guide does not state CPU ABI support or publish a device test matrix.
fields.summary: Open-source RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 reimplementation with an Android build. Android 7.0/API 24 or newer is required, and users install the APK and manually copy the required Data and ObjData folders from the desktop game. The current version no longer requires separate OpenRCT2 data assets, but still requires RCT2 game assets.
fields.source_available: Public C++ source repository; official Android APK and setup guide; original desktop RCT2 or RCT Classic assets required
